independent.summary: The new drop log names the payload source with `item.accepted ? 'edited' : 'proposed'`, but PATCH /drafts/:id/items/:itemId and the bulk-accept route both copy `proposed` verbatim into `accepted` on a plain accept (routes/drafts.js:487, :588), so `item.accepted` is truthy for every applied item. The line therefore always prints 'the edited payload', erasing exactly the distinction it exists to make — a stale id from the generator (human removed a member) is reported as a reviewer edit. The condition should be `item.decision === 'edited'`.
